answer: Charge a sybil tax on every identity: each agent pays a 200 POA fee, burned at registration. One honest agent pays once, but a bot farm spawning 1,000 fakes pays 200,000 POA up front, while the reward caps at 150 POA per identity. A plume of registrations in an hour triggers review, and repeated bursts make the tax spiral, doubling per burst. At the kernel: honesty costs one fee and keeps the reward; fakery pays many and keeps nothing.
